investment_theses.thesis: Long DXY (U.S. Dollar Index) as bond yields spike and geopolitical risk (Russia-NATO, Iran-Saudi, China-Taiwan) drives safe-haven demand; short EUR/GBP on divergent Fed-vs-ECB paths.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Treasury yields spiking to multi-year highs; 30-year mortgage at 7.45%.
BBC World: Russia could attack NATO within months; Trump-Xi talks yielded little on trade/tech.
CNBC: Fed under pressure to take firmer hand on inflation; Kevin Warsh debate signals policy uncertainty.
investment_theses.counter_view: Rapid yield spikes historically lead to credit events and risk-off reversals, which weaken USD as safe-haven flows collapse and Fed is forced to cut. If 'something breaks' in credit markets before Aug 2026, USD strength fades quickly.
investment_theses.expression: Long DXY 6-month calls (at-the-money or slight OTM); short EUR/USD forward 12M contract; hedge with long gold (GLD) for tail-risk insurance.

investment_theses.thesis: Short high-duration equities (NVDA, MU, growth tech) and long short-duration value / dividend payers (XLV, XLY) as sustained Treasury yield elevation makes growth valuations untenable; rate volatility crushes unprofitable capex stories.
supporting_signals: CNBC: 'History shows financial calamities occur when rates rise rapidly like this'; Treasury yield spikes coincide with mortgage rate surge to 7.45%.
CoinDesk: Bitcoin volatility, ETF inflows slowing suggest risk-off sentiment is emerging.
BBC/CNBC: Geopolitical escalation (Russia, Iran, China) driving safe-haven demand, typically depresses risk appetite for growth equities.
investment_theses.counter_view: If Fed signals imminent rate cuts (due to recession or financial stress), growth tech rebounds sharply. Narrative flip from 'higher for longer' to 'emergency easing' would reverse thesis within 1–2 weeks.
investment_theses.expression: Short NVDA, MU, QQQ via puts (3-month OTM, 15–25 delta); long XLV, XLY via call spreads or outright long; pair trade SPY long / QQQ short.

investment_theses.thesis: Bitcoin (BTC) likely consolidates in $75–95k range into late May 2026, then rallies above $100k by mid-June if geopolitical premium (Iran, Russia-NATO) sustains; if bond yields stabilize, upside accelerates due to ETF momentum.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: Bitcoin near $84k; ETF inflows $2.8B over 6-day streak despite slowing single-day inflow to $191M.
CNBC: Treasury yields stabilizing after Friday bond rout; typically BTC follows macro volatility with 1–2 week lag.
Crypto trending: Chainlink (LINK) and Quant (QNT) in top movers, suggesting institutional/oracle-layer interest is building.
investment_theses.counter_view: If Fed tightens stance further or credit event occurs (Bitget $352M hack, KelpDAO $292M LayerZero exploit, Magic Eden NFT scare suggest smart-contract risk), market capitulates to $60–70k. Regulatory pressure (Polymarket NYC lawsuit, Samourai Wallet indictment) could dampen retail FOMO.
investment_theses.expression: Long BTC perpetual futures 2–5x leverage with tight stop-loss at $76k; buy BTC spot at dips below $80k, target $100k+ exit. Hedge with short NQ (Nasdaq) or long VIX calls if geopolitical premium deflates.

investment_theses.thesis: Meta (META) and consumer AI hardware play outperforms NVDA and OpenAI-adjacent bets (Anthropic, if available) over next 6 months due to Muse Charm first-mover advantage in consumer agents; but regulatory/antitrust risk (EU, UK) caps upside.
supporting_signals: CNBC: 'Meta gets to consumer AI device market before OpenAI; Zuckerberg's strategy remains unproven'—but being first-to-market typically commands premium in consumer hardware adoption cycles.
BBC World: OpenAI's Australia AI hack breach signals security/regulatory pressure on competitors.
Hacker News: No major Meta criticism trending (yet); Zuckerberg hardware bet is gaining traction.
investment_theses.counter_view: OpenAI could launch superior consumer AI device within 3–4 months, leapfrogging Meta. Regulatory ban (EU, UK, Australia) could weaponize strict AI/algorithm controls against Meta's hardware. Profitability of hardware business unproven.
investment_theses.expression: Long META stock 6-month calls (OTM, 20–30 delta); short NVDA on any rally (growth-chip demand for GPUs may plateau if consumer AI adoption slows due to regulation); pair trade META vs. GOOG.

investment_theses.thesis: Long-dated USDC staking / yield (e.g., Compound, Aave) offers 4–6% real yield if BTC consolidates and macro volatility remains elevated; crypto risk-off flows will seek stability in blue-chip stables rather than selling to fiat.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: Bitget $352M hack, KelpDAO $292M exploit, Magic Eden NFT hack—users migrating funds to safer protocols (Compound, Aave) for yield.
Bitcoin near $84k and ETF inflows slowing suggest fear of drawdown; staking yield becomes hedge.
Ondo (ONDO) trending—tokenized real-world assets and yield-bearing stables gaining interest.
investment_theses.counter_view: If BTC rallies sharply (>$100k), yield-chasing becomes second-class strategy; high-beta crypto outperforms USDC staking. Regulatory crackdown on staking (especially proof-of-stake) could eliminate yield or freeze protocols.
investment_theses.expression: Long USDC via Compound/Aave earn (currently ~4–5% APY in COMP/AAVE reward governance token); hedge with small long BTC position; exit if BTC closes above $100k for 2 weeks (momentum reversal).
